name: canimcp-probe-host-mastra
description: Pins the @mastra/mcp and @mastra/core versions published from f21e0742ce, the 'chore: version packages' commit below the research pin b1f91397 (2026-11-08; the previous pin 027be9c5 was two commits above the same release). None of the commits between touch packages/mcp or packages/core/src/tools. Install with npm install --legacy-peer-deps: the mcp package's peer range excludes the core alpha it was published with.
